raw.excerpt: About Comfrt: Comfrt is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.
raw.description:
About Comfrt:
Comfrt is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.S. and the #1 apparel and home textile brand on TikTok globally. We design and deliver elevated basics rooted in mental well-being, comfort, and confidence. With over 4 million hoodies sold in just two years, we're expanding rapidly across apparel, home textile, and lifestyle categories — as well as into new international markets and retail channels. We're looking for a visionary Director of Quality Assurance to lead and scale our global quality organization across every product category we touch.


About the Role:
The Director of Quality Assurance is a senior leadership role responsible for building, scaling, and leading Comfrt's global quality function across both apparel and home textile categories. This position sets the strategic direction for quality across all product categories and global markets, ensuring our vendor base — particularly overseas manufacturing partners — meets and exceeds compliance and quality standards across the U.S., EU, Canada, Australia, and all emerging international markets.

The Director will partner closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams — including Product Development, Technical Design, and Retail Operations — to embed quality at every stage of the product lifecycle, from concept through final delivery. This role is critical to Comfrt's continued global growth and its commitment to delivering products that reflect our brand promise of comfort, quality, and confidence.


Key Responsibilities:
Strategic QA Leadership & Organizational Development
  • Own and drive the global QA strategy, frameworks, SOPs, and compliance standards across all vendors, categories, and countries of production — spanning both apparel and home textile product lines
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing QA team — both internal staff and external partners — to support Comfrt's rapid global expansion
  • Establish scalable QA infrastructure and systems capable of supporting significant growth across new product categories and international markets
  • Influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain quality as a core pillar of Comfrt's brand promise
  • Define and track KPIs for quality performance across the global supply chain, with regular executive reporting
Global Compliance & International Market Standards
  • Serve as Comfrt's subject-matter expert on apparel and home textile quality, safety, and regulatory compliance across all key international markets, including:
    • United States: CPSC, ASTM, CPSIA, FLSA, CA Prop 65, 16 CFR flammability standards for home textiles
    • European Union: REACH, GPSD, Textile Labeling Regulation, EN safety standards, EU Ecodesign regulations
    • Canada: CCPSA, Canada Consumer Product Safety Act, bilingual labeling requirements, Hazardous Products Act
    • Australia/New Zealand: ACCC, product safety standards, mandatory labeling laws
    • UK: UKCA marking, UK REACH, retained EU compliance post-Brexit, UK Furniture & Furnishings Fire Safety Regulations
    • Emerging markets as Comfrt continues international expansion
  • Proactively monitor and interpret evolving regulatory landscapes across international markets, assessing impact on product development, sourcing, and labeling strategies
  • Partner with Legal, Sourcing, and Product Development to ensure compliance is built into every product from inception, not retrofitted at the point of shipment
  • Lead international labeling strategy — including care labels, fiber content disclosure, country of origin, flammability warnings, and multilingual requirements — ensuring accuracy and compliance across all target markets for both apparel and home textile products
Retail & Channel Compliance
  • Develop and enforce compliance programs aligned with the requirements of major retail partners, including big-box, department store, specialty, and international retail channels
  • Own vendor compliance requirements for retail accounts, including routing guides, packaging standards, ticketing and labeling specs, and social compliance requirements
  • Partner with Merchandising teams to prepare for retail audits and compliance reviews, ensuring Comfrt consistently meets or exceeds retailer expectations across both apparel and home textile assortments
  • Oversee compliance for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and e-commerce channels, ensuring packaging, labeling, and product presentation meet platform and regulatory requirements
  • Establish and maintain documentation and reporting structures to support retail partners' vendor compliance programs
Quality Standards & Benchmarking — Apparel & Home Textile
  • Establish, document, and continuously evolve Comfrt's quality benchmarks across all product categories:
    • Apparel: Casual, Athleisure, Sleep, Activewear, Kids & Pet Apparel
    • Home Textile: Blankets, Throws, Pillows, Robes, Towels, Bedding, Cushions, and other soft home goods
    • Accessories: Handbags, Luggage, and lifestyle accessories
  • Define category-specific quality standards that address the unique performance requirements of home textiles — including pilling resistance, wash durability, shrinkage, fiber shedding, colorfastness, seam strength, and fill power for down/alternative fill products
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive quality assurance, testing, and inspection protocols aligned with both brand standards and market-specific regulatory requirements for each product category
  • Develop QA standards and protocols for new categories
  • Implement a Sealed Sample program and centralized approved sample library to ensure consistent inspection standards across all third-party and in-house inspections
Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement
  • Lead rapid root cause analysis for quality issues and drive corrective action plan management with vendors and internal teams
  • Champion a continuous improvement culture across the global supply chain, leveraging data and field insights to proactively prevent quality failures
  • Develop escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks for critical quality events, including potential recalls or market withdrawals
  • Analyze defect trends across product categories — including home textile-specific issues such as fiber shedding, delamination, fill migration, and thermal performance failures — and drive systemic fixes
Vendor Compliance & Performance Management
  • Own global vendor performance management, including quality scorecards, audits, corrective action plans, and ongoing factory evaluations across both apparel and home textile supply chains
  • Enforce adherence to quality standards across overseas vendors and factories in China, Vietnam, Cambodia, and other sourcing regions
  • Lead vendor training programs to build quality capability and compliance knowledge across the supply base, including specialized training for home textile manufacturers on fiber standards, filling materials, and construction requirements
  • Evaluate and onboard third-party inspection firms and accredited testing laboratories; define scope, manage relationships, and hold partners accountable to performance standards
Testing & Compliance Operations
  • Establish and maintain robust testing protocols ensuring all products meet performance, durability, safety, and regulatory standards across all applicable markets
  • Manage relationships with accredited testing laboratories and third-party inspection firms globally
  • Ensure all testing is conducted at accredited laboratories compliant with applicable market standards (OEKO-TEX, bluesign, or equivalent certifications where relevant)
  • Manage the expectations and schedule of 3rd party Asia QA team
Inspection Management
  • Manage the end-to-end inspection lifecycle: pre-production meetings, in-line inspections, size set approvals, and final inspections across all product categories
  • Ensure all third-party final inspections are conducted with properly established Sealed Samples and approved tech packs present
  • Define inspection criteria, AQL standards, and hold/release protocols appropriate to each product category — with specific criteria for home textile construction, filling, finishing, and packaging requirements
  • Oversee inspection of packaging compliance for home textile products, including labeling, care instructions, fiber content declarations, and country of origin accuracy
Documentation, Reporting & Visibility
  • Develop and maintain QA SOPs, inspection reports, compliance documentation, and quality dashboards across all product categories
  • Provide cross-functional teams — including Merchandising, Sourcing, Finance, and executive leadership — with timely, actionable quality visibility
  • Maintain comprehensive records to support retailer compliance audits, regulatory inquiries, and internal reviews
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Training
  • Partner with Product Development, Technical Design, Sourcing, and Operations to ensure quality is built in from concept through production to final inspection — for both apparel and home textile development pipelines
  • Collaborate with the Design and PD teams during the home textile development process to ensure fiber selection, construction methods, and finishing treatments meet both aesthetic intent and quality/compliance standards
  • Lead quality training programs for internal teams and vendor partners to continuously elevate standards and build organizational capability
  • Collaborate with international business development and retail teams to ensure QA readiness for new market entries and retail account launches
Skills & Qualifications
Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in quality assurance/quality control within apparel and/or home textile manufacturing
  • Experience across both soft goods categories strongly preferred — apparel AND home textiles (blankets, bedding, pillows, throws, towels, robes, or similar)
  • 10+ years of people management experience, with a demonstrated track record of building and scaling QA teams
  • Extensive experience working with overseas vendors across China, Vietnam, Cambodia, and other global sourcing regions
  • Proven experience managing quality across multiple international markets simultaneously (US, EU, Canada, Australia, UK)
  • Experience supporting major retail accounts and navigating retailer compliance programs
  • Background in both DTC/e-commerce and wholesale/retail channels strongly preferred.
Technical Knowledge
  • Expert knowledge of U.S., EU, Canada, Australia, and UK quality, safety, and regulatory compliance standards for both apparel and home textile products
  • Strong working knowledge of home textile-specific testing standards: AATCC, ASTM home textile methods, flammability standards (16 CFR 1610, 16 CFR 1632/1633 where applicable), and fill material regulations
  • Familiarity with sustainable textile certifications (OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS, bluesign, Responsible Down Standard) as they apply to home textile and apparel products
  • Deep fluency in international labeling requirements — including care labels, fiber content, country of origin, flammability disclosures, and multilingual compliance across target markets
  • Proven ability to conduct vendor audits, factory inspections, and targeted vendor training programs
  • Strong understanding of retail routing, packaging, and vendor compliance requirements across major retail channels
Leadership & Communication
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and inspire a QA team while influencing senior stakeholders and driving organizational change
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex, fast-moving information — connecting signals from vendors, the field, and internal teams into clear, actionable direction
  • Proactive in formulating approaches to QA issue resolution and keeping all stakeholders aligned on problem status, remediation trajectory, and resolution
  • Superior fluency with digital communication tools (Slack, WhatsApp, Google Meet, Zoom) and analytical tools (MS Excel, Google Sheets), with the ability to coach team members on effective use
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones
Other Requirements
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally for vendor visits, factory audits, inspections, and retail partner meetings
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and leadership skills across vendor, retail, and internal teams
  • Solutions-driven mindset with a strong sense of urgency and accountability
  • Can operate successfully in Fast pace high sku count business

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Learn more about our benefits here;

Hi, I'm Daniele, VP of Engineering at Airalo!

Engineering drives Airalo’s eSIM platform. We build the product that lets millions of people connect instantly across the globe. The challenges are exciting: high-scale systems, carrier integrations, and products spanning both B2C and B2B. What matters most to us is creating an environment where engineers can do their best work. Real ownership, autonomy, and a direct link between what you ship and business outcomes are key. You’ll work with smart, motivated people who take their craft seriously. If you want to build things that matter at global scale, this is where you do it.

Airalo’s fully remote Engineering team is growing. In this role, you'll tackle complex technical challenges across our product ecosystem, helping build, innovate, and scale the platform that keeps millions of travellers connected worldwide.

As our Senior DevSecOps Engineer, you will be the guardian of Airalo’s global infrastructure and applications. This isn't just about maintaining compliance, it’s a hands-on opportunity to spearhead our shift-left security strategy, centralise AWS governance, and proactively outsmart malicious attacks. If you are excited to design robust defences that slash attack vectors by 50% while scaling a secure ecosystem for millions of travellers, this is your chance to take true technical ownership.

On Call

    Participating in our on-call rotation is a core expectation of this role. It's essential for maintaining 24/7 service reliability across our global operations, ensuring our systems remain resilient and our customers experience uninterrupted service, regardless of time zone or geography.
    - Paid Rotation: We offer standby fees + overtime pay.
    - Delayed Start: No on-call duties for your first 6 months.
    - Rest & Recovery: Guaranteed rest periods and flexible hours following night incidents.
    - Shared Load: Rotations are split (Weekdays vs. Weekends) to minimize fatigue.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage security solutions across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC), with a focus on automation and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including robust API security measures and authentication protocols.
  • Champion security best practices within engineering, DevOps, SRE, and IT teams, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for security.
  • Proactively identify and remediate security vulnerabilities in applications, mitigating OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, infrastructure, and cloud services through threat modelling, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing.
  • Develop and maintain security monitoring and alerting solutions to detect and respond to potential security incidents in real-time and prevent common cyber attacks such as DDoS, injection attacks, and credential stuffing.
  • Define and enforce secure coding standards and provide training and mentorship to development teams on DevSecOps principles.
  • Lead compliance initiatives by contributing to security policies, controls, and audit readiness for SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and other relevant regulations.

Must-haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevSecOps, Security Engineering, or a similar role with a strong focus on cloud security.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with AWS services, including expertise in container orchestration, IAM, and security best practices.
  • 2+ years of experience with Kubernetes, including securing Kubernetes clusters and deployments.
  • Deep understanding of SAST, DAST, and container security solutions, and API security testing tools, along with experience implementing and managing these tools.
  • Proven experience in vulnerability assessment, threat modelling, and remediation techniques.
  • Experience with security incident response, including developing incident response plans and conducting post-mortems.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, Java, etc.) for automation and tooling.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Business Operations Manager - Job Description
Employment Type:Full-time, Remote
Reports To: Founder & CEO
Working Hours: Aligned to AEST business hours
About the Opportunity
Remote Office is a global talent infrastructure company helping Australian businesses build and manage high-performing offshore teams. Shift AI is an execution infrastructure company that helps businesses scale through intentional automation and AI agent deployment.
Both businesses are growing. As for the Founder of the businesses, the time needs to move toward building - not running. This role exists to take the operational layer off entirely.
The person in this seat will own execution across two businesses - covering operations, finance, people, compliance, and commercial function. This is not a coordination role. It is an ownership role. You will make decisions, hold accountability, and drive outcomes without needing to be managed.
If you are looking for a role where your manager tells you what to do next, this is not it. If you are someone who sees the gap, fills it, and reports back with the outcome - read on.
What You Will Own
Operations & Execution
  • Drive organisational performance across both businesses by coordinating with the sales team, setting targets, and tracking delivery against those targets
  • Manage HR project management across the full talent lifecycle - structure, compliance, documentation, advisory, and escalation
  • Handle people management matters including disputes and sensitive situations; escalate only what genuinely requires the Founder's involvement
  • Be the practising custodian of organisational culture - you model it, reinforce it, and hold the team to it
Finance & Commercial
  • Execute financial transactions and maintain clean financial records in coordination with the accounts team
  • Own client invoicing - accuracy, timeliness, and follow-through are non-negotiable
  • Own all tool and software subscription management - renewals, cancellations, cost reviews
  • Optimise operational costs and contribute to pricing and cost strategy across both businesses
  • Formulate talent cost strategy across regions, accounting for market rates, compliance obligations, and business margins
  • Handle corporate structure matters and tax planning with appropriate professional stakeholders
Legal & Contracts
  • Draft, review, and manage commercial contracts, contractor agreements, service agreements, and internal employment documentation
  • Make sound commercial and compliance decisions within your authority; flag edge cases appropriately
Communication & Presentation
  • Prepare business presentations for internal and external use as required - Canva proficiency is expected
  • Collaborate regularly with clients, team members, and relevant external parties in a professional and clear manner
What We Are Looking For
Non-negotiables
  • Fluent English - written and spoken; your communication must be clear, precise, and professional
  • Demonstrable experience across operations, finance, and HR - not one of these, all of them
  • A decision-maker, not a task-taker - you must be comfortable owning outcomes
  • High integrity and discretion - you will be handling sensitive financial, legal, and people matters
  • Systems thinker - you see processes, not just tasks; you build for durability, not convenience
Strong Edge
  • Proficiency with AI tools and automation - ClickUp, Slack, Zoho Books, and AI agents
  • Experience working across multi-entity or cross-border business structures
  • Familiarity with Australian business compliance context
  • Contract drafting experience beyond templates
The Kind of Person We Are Looking For
The title is Operations Manager. The reality is closer to a business partner.
We value calm over urgency, clarity over volume, and ownership over effort. We do not reward heroics - we reward systems. If you are the kind of person who builds the right process and then lets it run, you will fit here.
What You Can Expect
  • A role with genuine scope and real decision-making authority
  • Direct access to the Founder - you are not buried in a hierarchy
  • A team that values clarity, ownership, and doing things properly
  • The tools, structure, and context to do your job well - not just the title
Remote Office and Shift AI are equal opportunity employers. We hire based on capability, character, and fit - nothing else.

raw.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Job Description

The Field Service Specialist II is an experienced field professional responsible for the commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of Copeland control systems and refrigeration equipment. This role demands a deep understanding of refrigeration system operation, control strategies, and integration with HVAC and building management systems. Field work will be required with extensive overnight travel. The Field Services Specialist II is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport and communications with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives, and others as appropriate. 

 

AS A FIELD SERVICE SPECIALIST II, YOU WILL:

  • Commission and verify control systems for refrigeration and HVAC applications (E2, E3, Site Supervisors,etc). 

  • Troubleshoot system issues both on-site and remotely, ensuringoptimalperformance. 

  • Develop andmodifycontroller programs from I/O legends or existing sequences. 

  • Execute new store commissioning and remodel commissioning projects, ensuring all documentation is completed accurately. 

  • Provide site-level customer support and training for contractors and end users. 

  • Review and interpret store prints, electrical schematics, and project specifications. 

  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Engineers, and Technical Support on project execution. 

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of third-party control systems and network integrations. 

  • Ensure all work meets safety and compliance standards. 

 

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on field experience in refrigeration, controls, or commissioning. 

  • Advanced understanding of refrigeration cycle operation (compressors, valves, racks, cases). 

  • Knowledge of building automation systems and HVAC control logic. 

  • CO₂trans-criticalor cascade system experience highly preferred. 

  • Proficiencywith Modbus, BACnet, and other communication protocols preferred.  

  • Computer skills including Microsoft Office products, databases, Internet software, E-mail, Windows, etc.  

  • Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple site assignments. 

  • Ability to travel up to 85–90%. 

  • Legal work authorization in the United States - Sponsorship will not be provided for this role 

Remote Work Arrangement:  

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you maybe requiredto travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand yourteamoperating principles to collaborate effectively. 

Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which weoperate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process.In accordance withColorado EPEWA, the salary/pay range for this role is$80,000-$104,000 annually,commensuratewith the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.

Working Conditions:  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee isfrequentlyexposed to moving mechanical parts, outside weather conditions, extreme cold, extreme heat, and risk of electrical shock. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, high precarious places, fumes or airborne particles, and vibration. 

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

Work Authorization

Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

About Comfrt:

Comfrt LLC is the fastest growing ecommerce brand built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle, we are obsessed with our customer and dedicated to building the ultimate comfort brand ecosystem.

About the Role:

The Senior Director of Product Development will lead the Product Development organization across apparel and lifestyle categories, overseeing Directors, Product Managers, Developers and Coordinators. This leader will be responsible for scaling process, elevating team capability, driving product excellence, and ensuring seamless execution from design vision through production readiness.This leader will play a critical role in shaping the future product vision of the brand through a deep understanding of the modern premium casual, athletic, and sportswear customer.

This role requires a strategic operator and strong people leader who can balance innovation, speed, quality, margin, and business growth in a fast-paced global environment. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for trend, understands the intersection of fashion, function, and culture, and can identify meaningful white space opportunities within the market. This person must be highly connected to evolving consumer behavior, trend shifts, silhouette evolution, fabric innovation, and competitive landscape across casual sportswear and athleisure. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, detail-oriented, solutions-driven, and thrives in building high-performing teams and scalable systems.

In addition to strong trend and product instincts, this leader must be an exceptional operator capable of scaling teams, improving process, driving product excellence, and ensuring seamless execution from concept through commercialization.


Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Organizational Development
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Product Development organization, including Directors, Product Managers, Developers and Coordinators.
  • Build strong team structure, clear ownership, accountability, and scalable workflows across categories and business channels.
  • Develop talent and succession planning to strengthen organizational capability and long-term growth.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, urgency, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor teams to focus on delivering business impact, not simply timelines.
Product Development Strategy & Execution
  • Own end-to-end product development execution from concept through commercialization across apparel and lifestyle categories.
  • Identify emerging trends, customer behaviors, and market white space opportunities across casual sportswear, activewear, and lifestyle categories.
  • Partner closely with Creative, Merchandising and Design to develop category-driving product strategies and commercially impactful big ideas.
  • Maintain strong awareness of competitive landscape, market shifts, fabric innovation, silhouette trends, and consumer insights.
  • Partner closely with Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Technical Design, Production, Planning, and Quality teams to bring product vision to life.
  • Ensure product meets brand standards for quality, fit, performance, cost, margin, and customer expectations.
  • Drive process optimization and operational rigor to improve speed-to-market, communication, and execution consistency.
  • Lead cross-functional milestone management and seasonal calendar execution.
Product Excellence & Quality
  • Establish best-in-class product development standards, SOPs, and commercialization processes.
  • Identify risks early and proactively solve development, quality, fit, and production challenges.
  • Partner with sourcing and manufacturing teams to elevate vendor capability, innovation, and execution.
  • Ensure product integrity through strong development, testing, wear trials, and quality assurance processes.
Business & Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Partner with executive leadership on product strategy, category growth opportunities, and organizational scaling.
  • Collaborate closely with merchandising and planning teams to align product decisions with business goals, inventory strategy, margin targets, and customer demand.
  • Support quarterly and seasonal planning processes, ensuring teams are focused on the highest-impact initiatives.
  • Use customer insights, market trends, competitive analysis, and data to inform product and process decisions.
Operational Leadership
  • Drive scalable systems, tools, reporting, and workflow management across the development organization.
  • Improve visibility, accountability, and communication across cross-functional teams and global partners.
  • Balance innovation, speed, quality, and profitability while operating in a high-growth environment.
  • Lead by example as a hands-on operator willing to solve problems and support teams where needed.
Skills & Qualifications

Experience
  • 15+ years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, or Product Operations within apparel, retail, or consumer goods.
  • Proven experience leading fast pace, lean product development organizations in high-growth environments.
  • Experience managing and leading Directors, Product Managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of apparel product creation, commercialization, fit, materials, quality, costing, sourcing, and production processes.
  • Experience working across DTC, retail, wholesale, and global business channels preferred.
  • Strong eye for product, silhouette, fabric, color, and trend relevance within the active/lifestyle market.
  • Premium, fashion, activewear, or lifestyle brand experience strongly preferred.
Leadership
  • Proven ability to coach, develop, and elevate teams and organizational capability.
  • Strong servant-leadership mindset with the ability to influence through collaboration and trust.
  • Comfortable operating both strategically and tactically in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
Business & Operational Acumen
  • Strong understanding of margin management, calendar management, inventory flow, and operational scaling.
  • Highly analytical with the ability to use data and customer insights to drive decisions.
  • Demonstrated success improving processes, driving efficiency, and scaling operations.
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional relationships and competing priorities.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Product Excellence
  • Team Leadership & Coaching
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Process Optimization
  • Quality & Commercialization Expertise
  • Operational Rigor
  • Problem Solving
  • Customer-Centric Mindset
  • Agility & Adaptability

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

raw.description:
About Comfrt:
Comfrt LLC is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.S. and the #1 Apparel Brand on TikTok globally—built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle. Our elevated basics are worn by millions and loved for their perfect mix of comfort, style, and cultural relevance.

About the Role:

The Associate Designer will support the design and development of fleece and lounge apparel. This role is responsible for helping create trend-right, commercially successful products that aligns with Comfrt's brand vision, aesthetic, and quality standards. You will assist in taking product from concept through production, including trend research, sketching, color development, tech pack updates, sample review, and vendor communication.

You will partner closely with Design, Product Development, Technical Design, Merchandising, Production, and overseas vendors to bring innovative, comfort-driven products to market. The ideal candidate has 4-5+ years of experience, a strong understanding of the female consumer, and a passion for fashion, trends, and product innovation. They are highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where speed, creativity, and execution are equally important.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the team in taking product from initial concept through to production, including tech pack creation and updates post-fitting
  • Assist with sketching new styles and silhouettes for upcoming seasons
  • Maintain day-to-day vendor communication and help execute necessary updates in a timely manner
  • Keep Miro boards up to date with current sketches, colorways, and style information
  • Take the lead on general bookkeeping and administrative tasks for the design team
  • Research emerging trends through market shopping, social media, competitor analysis, runway, and vintage references — helping to shape seasonal mood and trend direction
  • Over time, and with experience, grow into owning and managing individual product categories
Who You Are:
  • 4–5+ years of apparel design experience, preferably within fast-fashion, contemporary, athleisure, lifestyle, or youth-focused brands.
  • Experience working for brands with a strong fashion point of view and high SKU count, where speed to market and trend relevance are critical.
  • Strong understanding of the female customer, including current trends, silhouettes, styling preferences, and emerging cultural influences.
  • Passionate about fashion, social media, trend forecasting, and understanding what is driving consumer demand.
  • Exceptional taste level with the ability to identify and translate trends into commercially successful products.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented and execution-focused, ensuring accuracy across sketches, tech packs, colorways, trims, and development samples.
  • Able to work autonomously, manage deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently while maintaining strong communication with cross-functional partners.
  • High-energy individual with a positive attitude and strong sense of urgency.
  • Deep appreciation for the Comfrt brand and an understanding of how comfort, wellness, community, and trend-driven fashion can coexist.

Experience, Technical Skills & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop; strong sketching and presentation skills are required.
  • Ability to conduct competitive research, market analysis, and trend forecasting to identify white-space opportunities for the brand.
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, fabrications, print techniques, embellishments, and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with Design, Product Development, Merchandising, Production, and Sourcing teams.
  • Portfolio Required — Please include a portfolio with your application showcasing your design range, sketching ability, and eye for trend.

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

raw.description:
About Comfrt:
Comfrt is the fastest growing ecommerce brand built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle. We are obsessed with our customer and dedicated to building the ultimate comfort brand ecosystem.

About the Role:
The Design Director – Fleece is responsible for defining and driving Comfrt's fleece product vision across hoodies, sweatpants, shorts, outerwear, and future fleece-based categories. As Comfrt's largest and most important product category, fleece serves as the foundation of the brand, driving the majority of sales, customer acquisition, and brand recognition. This role is responsible for setting the fleece product direction that influences the overall brand strategy, customer experience, and future growth of the business.

This leadership role combines strategic thinking, creative direction, and hands-on product design to ensure Comfrt remains the market leader in comfort-driven apparel. The Fleece Design Director will establish the category product vision, aesthetic direction, and innovation roadmap for the category while leading a team of designers and partnering cross-functionally to deliver best-in-class products that support both brand and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Creative & Product Leadership

  • Own and evolve Comfrt's fleece product aesthetic, design language, and category vision
  • Establish a clear point of view on fit, proportion, silhouette, fabric, color, wash, and construction details
  • Translate customer insights, sales performance, trend research, and market opportunities into commercially successful assortments
  • Drive seasonal and long-term fleece product strategy across all core and emerging categories
  • Ensure all products remain authentic to Comfrt's brand DNA while introducing meaningful innovation

Product Design & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept through production approval
  • Oversee silhouette development, fit, trims, graphics, branding, wash treatments, and construction details
  • Partner closely with Product Development and Technical Design to ensure products meet quality, fit, margin, and timeline requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement of Comfrt's core fleece programs while introducing newness and innovation
  • Maintain a strong understanding of consumer needs, comfort expectations, and product performance

Trend, Fabric & Innovation

  • Lead trend research across fashion, streetwear, lifestyle, wellness, and comfort categories
  • Identify emerging product opportunities, white space, and future growth categories
  • Partner with Fabric Development to elevate fleece innovation, fabric hand feel, performance, sustainability, and comfort
  • Drive innovation in fleece construction, garment washes, finishes, and functional product features
  • Stay ahead of industry trends while maintaining a unique brand perspective

Business & Merchandising Partnership

  • Collaborate with Merchandising, Product Development, and Planning to build assortments that support sales, margin, and inventory objectives
  • Utilize sales reports, market analysis, customer feedback, and business insights to influence product strategy
  • Understand category performance at the SKU and style level to identify opportunities and risks
  • Participate in assortment architecture, category planning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap development
  • Balance creativity with commercial decision-making to maximize business results

Team Leadership & Design Operations

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of designers across fleece and related product categories
  • Establish clear priorities, creative direction, and accountability across the design organization
  • Build scalable design processes that support rapid growth while maintaining design excellence
  • Own the design calendar and ensure all milestones and deliverables are completed on time
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, speed, and continuous improvement

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Development, Technical Design, Sourcing, Merchandising, Marketing, and Creative teams
  • Align product strategy with business objectives, launch calendars, and operational capabilities
  • Collaborate on product storytelling, campaign concepts, and seasonal launches
  • Support vendor partnerships by providing clear design direction and product vision
  • Ensure design intent is maintained throughout development and production


Qualifications:

  • 12-15+ years of apparel design experience, with significant experience in fleece, sportswear, casualwear, or comfort-driven apparel
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing and developing design teams
  • Strong understanding of fleece fabrics, garment construction, fit, washes, trims, and manufacturing processes
  • Proven ability to build commercially successful assortments that drive growth
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage sales data, market insights, and customer feedback to inform decisions
  • Deep understanding of fashion trends, consumer behavior, and competitive market dynamics
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and leadership skills
  • Highly organized with exceptional project management and prioritization abilities
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment


Leadership Profile

  • A visionary product leader with a strong aesthetic point of view and passion for product excellence
  • Strategic thinker who can connect design decisions to business outcomes
  • Confident decision-maker who can challenge ideas and influence cross-functional partners
  • Highly collaborative while maintaining clear creative ownership
  • Obsessed with product quality, customer experience, and continuous innovation
  • Comfortable leading through ambiguity and building structure within a rapidly growing organization
  • Leader who thrives in a high-growth, high-SKU, fast-paced environment and can effectively manage significant product volume while maintaining exceptional creative and operational standards
  • Driven by results, accountability, and a desire to build industry-leading products

What Success Looks Like:
  • Establish a clear and compelling design vision for Comfrt's fleece business, the brand's largest and most influential category.
  • Consistently deliver trend-right, commercially successful products that strengthen Comfrt's market leadership and drive business growth.
  • Elevate product quality, fit, fabric innovation, and overall customer experience across all fleece categories.
  • Build and develop a high-performing design team capable of supporting a fast-paced, high-growth, high-SKU business.
  • Drive innovation while maintaining the integrity of Comfrt's brand DNA and core product pillars.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships that enable speed, accountability, and best-in-class product execution.
  • Create scalable processes that improve efficiency, accelerate speed to market, and support the continued growth of the brand.
  • Shape the future direction of Comfrt through product leadership, category expansion, and continuous innovation.

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

About Comfrt:
Comfrt LLC is the fastest growing ecommerce brand built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle. We are obsessed with our customer and dedicated to building the ultimate comfort brand ecosystem.

About the Role:
The Product Development Manager - Home owns the end-to-end execution of fashion-forward, brand relevant products, from concept through market launch. This role sits at the intersection of innovation, product strategy, technical development, and merchandising, ensuring product is brand-right, performance-led, and commercially successful.

You will partner closely with Merchandising, Design, Sourcing, QA, Production (as a key execution partner), Operations, Inventory, and Marketing to bring new collections to life while continuously elevating product quality, fabric innovation, and speed to market.

This role is for someone deeply obsessed with product, fashion, and detail—from fabric and fit to silhouette and finish—while also understanding how great products must perform in the market.

What You Will Do:
Product Development & Technical Execution
  • Own the full product lifecycle from concept through launch
  • Translate brand vision, performance needs, and trends into technically sound, fashion-forward product
  • Lead development across performance knits and fleece.
  • Create and maintain detailed tech packs including construction, measurements, materials, trims, and performance requirements
  • Own fit development, driving fittings to achieve optimal comfort, mobility, and silhouette
  • Manage prototypes, sampling, wash approvals, and shade consistency
  • Lead daily communication with vendors to ensure clear execution and timely progress
Fashion, Trend & Fabric Expertise
  • Maintain a deep understanding of fashion trends, consumer behavior, retail dynamics, and fabric innovation within athleisure and outerwear
  • Continuously research and stay ahead of fabric trends, new materials, and performance technologies
  • Proactively test, evolve, and elevate fabrics to improve handfeel, durability, and performance
  • Partner closely with the Fabric Manager to refine core fabric platforms and drive material innovation
  • Translate macro and micro trends—across fashion and performance—into brand-right, commercially viable product
  • Ensure assortments feel current, cohesive, elevated, and differentiated Collaborate with Design to align silhouettes, color, and materials with brand DNA
Merchandising, Line Planning & Market Strategy
  • Own competitive market analysis across knit and fleece categories, with a strong understanding of trends, pricing, and white space opportunities
  • Analyze sales performance, margin, sell-through, returns, and customer feedback to inform product decisions
  • Deep understanding of the brand demographic, strong eye for trend, understands the intersection of fashion, function, and culture, and can identify meaningful white space opportunities within the market
  • Drive seasonal line plans, SKU architecture, and assortment strategies within category Balance core, seasonal, and newness to support growth and innovation
  • Support pricing strategy based on product value, complexity, and market positioning
  • Partner with Planning, Finance, and Inventory to align product strategy with forecasts and business targets
Operations & Product Development Execution

  • Partner with Operations, Production, and Inventory to ensure product delivers on time and in the right selling window
  • Proactively manage timelines and dependencies, identifying and resolving risks early
  • Ensure product readiness across development, QA, merchandising, and marketing ahead of launch
  • Drive cross-functional alignment to support successful, on-time product launches
Cross-Functional Partnership (Including Production)
  • Partner closely with Production as a key execution partner to ensure smooth handoff from development into bulk
  • Ensure Production teams receive complete and accurate product information
  • Collaborate with Sourcing and Finance to balance cost, quality, and performance
  • Review QA inspection and testing reports in partnership with QA prior to shipment
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks across fit, fabric, construction, cost, and timing
What You Can Bring:
  • 6+ years of experience in product development and/or merchandising within lounge, home, lifestyle, or related comfort-driven categories
  • Strong technical expertise in performance fabrics, garment construction, and fit
  • Experience across both knit (athleisure) and woven/insulated outerwear preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Apparel Design, Product Development, Textiles, or related field
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop
  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables)
  • Experience with PLM systems and tools like Asana or Notion
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Who You Are:
  • A highly strategic product thinker with the ability to build and articulate clear product strategies
  • A well-rounded product expert fluent in fabric, fit, performance, and silhouette
  • Obsessed with great product, with a strong fashion aesthetic and elevated taste level
  • Fabric-forward and curious, continuously researching and evolving materials to elevate quality and innovation
  • A hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who takes ownership from idea through execution
  • Entrepreneurial and innovative, balancing creativity with strong business judgment
  • A strong fashion and market thinker with a clear point of view on trends and competition
  • Both creative and data-driven, able to translate insights into action
  • A clear, confident communicator and strong cross-functional partner
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, start-up environment with evolving priorities
What Success Looks Like:
  • Product launches on time, on brand, and at performance expectations
  • Fabrics, fit, and construction consistently meet high quality and comfort standards
  • Assortments are intentional, elevated, and commercially strong
  • Product decisions are driven by data, customer insight, and market awareness
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned and execution is seamless

Why Join Comfrt?

raw.description:
About Kiddie Kredit

Our startup has raised a pre-seed round and is looking to hire engineers for exciting, unique projects. As an early member of the engineering team you will have input on decisions and a lot of potential impact.

This position is fully remote and available to anyone within 3 hours of US EST time zone.

Our Team

Our team is an all-star cast composed of a CEO who has won multiple pitch competitions and been accepted into several accelerators, a CMO who has developed several web properties with millions of users each, and a CTO who was a team lead at AWS and has experience building systems that can stand up to 40 million requests per hour.

Our Product

We are a B2B2C platform and have some very powerful strategic partners. Our most exciting opportunities involve our partnerships with Equifax and YMCA Atlanta in order to add business-level integrations to our consumer app.

Our Stack

MongoDB Atlas, Node, React, React Native, identity with Auth0, JavaScript, Typescript, and AWS. Heavily using infrastructure as code.

Job Qualifications

  • You are able to work full time, within 3 hours of US EST time zone.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a paid software engineer working at a company where the primary product is software, or working at a software development agency. This is not negotiable.

- Deep knowledge of Javascript

  • Understanding of http and server technologies

- Knowledge of ReactJS

- Computer Science background

  • Excellent written English, and basic conversational English (our CTO speaks Spanish but we want code written in English and we want to be able to communicate in English during team meetings)

The ideal candidate

The skill we value and need the most is the ability to understand product requirements and translate them into working code while aligning with business goals. When the product team asks for something in a two month timeline that would take over a year to build, you should be able to push back and negotiate. You should be able to ask questions like

  • How do we solve this customer need and validate our assumptions without building all this custom software?
  • Is there a pre-existing saas we can use in order to implement this whole subsystem?
  • Can we get rid of this feature entirely?

The day-to-day of the job

At a high level, you will be the chief system designer, provide mentorship to other devs, and be the bridge between product requirements and the business team.

Salary: $40.00 - $70.00 / hr

raw.excerpt: About Comfrt Comfrt LLC is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.
raw.description:
About Comfrt
Comfrt LLC is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.S. and the #1 Apparel Brand on TikTok globally—built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle. Our elevated basics are worn by millions and loved for their perfect mix of comfort, style, and cultural relevance.

Role Overview
We are looking for a data-driven storyteller to join our team as a Digital Data Analyst. In this role, you won't just pull reports; you will analyze the customer’s digital journey and directly inform business and marketing decisions. You will leverage Fullstory to identify friction points, explain marketing performance, and provide the insights necessary to optimize our digital experiences, drive conversion and long-term retention goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Site Analytics Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for Digital Analytics, maintaining dashboards and performing deep-dive analysis on traffic patterns, user flow and campaign impacts
  • Journey Mapping: Analyze complex site journeys to understand how users move through the funnel. Identify where users drop off and why, how they navigate the site and how to impact their journeys
  • Insight Communication: Translate complex data sets into "so-what" insights for stakeholders in Marketing, Ecommerce, Product, and CX
  • Testing & Optimization: Support A/B and multivariate testing programs by providing the ‘why’ behind the results
  • Implementation Support: Work closely with developers and tagging teams to maintain accurate tagging and compliant tracking

Technical Requirements

  • Digital Analytics: 2+ years of hands-on experience in a digital analytics role with Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics
  • Tagging/Implementation: Familiarity with Google Tag Manager, AppsFlyer and other event tagging tools is a major plus
  • Visualization: Ability to build and maintain automated, easy-to-digest dashboards in analytics platforms and BI tools (eg Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Adobe Workspace)
  • SQL Knowledge: Strong ability to query databases to merge site data with backend customer data is desirable

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years in a digital analytics or web-focused data role
  • Analytical Mindset: You don't just see a number; you want to find out what caused it and how to impact it
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to tell an easily digestible story with actionable insights from complex analysis and datasets

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

General Application

Help create a more human world of work alongside a community of amazing, like-minded experts in a human organization.

Unlock your full potential through a career that enables you to develop personally, professionally and even spiritually.

We're always looking for good people who might be a great fit with our culture, and who value the things we think are important. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you!

If you would like to be considered for current or future opportunities here at Potential Project International, please send us your CV and motivation letter.

About Potential Project

At Potential Project, our purpose is to create a more human world of work through harnessing the full potential of the mind. In this new world of work, people are focused, calm and resilient, even happy at work. There is time for connection and compassion for one another, even on the busiest days. This new world begins inside, in the mind.

Potential Project is a global research and leadership development firm that partners with leading organizations to uncover the power of the mind – how it is wired and how to rewire it for new behaviors and different outcomes. Through integrating cutting-edge neuroscience, evidence-based research and contemplative practices from the wisdom traditions, we have helped over 450,000 individuals and 500 clients to enhance performance, resilience and creativity and to develop leaders who are more agile, compassionate and courageous.

We are present in 20+ countries with a network of 50+ facilitators, and we serve hundreds of forward-thinking companies like McKinsey, IKEA, Unilever, Cisco, LEGO and Microsoft.

We Offer

  • Opportunity to work in a highly collaborative, mindful, collegial work context with amazing colleagues from all over the world

  • Opportunity to go on meditation retreats and balance professional development with inner development

  • Ability to work from home.

How to submit your application

If you are interested, please send us your CV and a motivation letter by clicking on the "Apply" button.

Potential Project is a people-centered company. It is what we teach and what we live. We insist on our team having a truly human experience of their work. Potential Project has committed itself to inclusion, respect for difference, and fairness, and guarantees the same rights to all its team members to ensure the fullest degree of success for each individual and for the organization.

Job Description:

We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States. But more than our size, it’s our people and culture that set us apart. We believe great things happen when people are supported, challenged, and given the freedom to do their very best work. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where your career and personal life can thrive together – where you have the flexibility to manage your time, the resources to grow, and a team that genuinely cares about your success.

We’ve been employee-owned since 2001, giving every team member a stake in our collective success. This ownership mentality fosters a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and excellence – where new ideas are welcomed, different perspectives are valued, and you’re encouraged to explore what excites you most. Whether you’re expanding your skills, tackling new challenges, or making an impact beyond the office, we provide the resources and support to help you grow in the direction that’s right for you.

At KSM, your contributions matter – not just to the firm, but to your colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve across the U.S. If you’re looking for a place where you can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow in ways that align with what’s most important to you, we’d love to meet you.

Position Summary:

The Manager, Audit Technical Resource Group supports the delivery of high-quality audit and assurance services by providing technical guidance, quality review support, and practical resources to engagement teams. This role applies professional standards to complex accounting, auditing, and financial reporting matters, helping teams navigate technical issues and maintain compliance with firm and regulatory requirements.

Through technical consultation, training, and collaboration, the Manager strengthens the capabilities of client-facing professionals, promotes consistency in the application of professional standards, and contributes to the firm's commitment to audit quality and technical excellence.

Responsibilities:

Technical Execution

  • Perform Report Quality Reviews (RQRs) across a variety of engagement types and industries
  • Research, analyze, and formally document technical accounting and auditing issues to ensure GAAP compliance
  • Respond to advanced technical inquiries using professional standards and research tools
  • Develop and update technical tools, templates, training materials, and whitepaper guidance on complex accounting issues
  • Participate in internal inspections, peer reviews, and quality management activities, including documentation and follow-up
  • Deliver and support technical training through firmwide programs such as TRG News and Technically Speaking webinars
  • Develop and maintain advanced knowledge of accounting and auditing standards, including new and emerging guidance
  • Maintain current knowledge of GAAP, professional standards, and technology platforms relevant to assurance services

Workflow, Communication & Collaboration

  • Support KSM staff with ad hoc technical, quality, risk, and independence matters
  • Contribute to innovation and compliance initiatives within the Audit practice
  • Enhance marketing efforts by contributing thought leadership articles, whitepapers, and guidance on technical matters
  • Collaborate with Audit leadership to support execution of technical quality and operational initiatives across the Audit practice
  • Partner with internal communications on current assurance and accounting concepts, process improvements, and changes

Requirements/Qualifications:

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting (Master's degree a plus)
  • Active CPA license in good standing

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in public accounting or audit services with a technical focus
  • Demonstrated experience researching, interpreting, and applying accounting and auditing standards to complex matters
  • Experience mentoring or supervising audit professionals
  • Solid background in US GAAP and knowledge of current audit and accounting concepts
  • Ability to research technical issues and create or review documentation and memos supporting accounting and internal control matters

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.

KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent by staffing agencies and fee-based referral services will not be considered outside of a signed KSM vendor contract. KSM will not pay a fee to recruiters or agencies that do not have a signed KSM vendor contract.

The Opportunity

You’ll be at the forefront of ensuring platform quality, helping creators monetize their work, access premium brand opportunities, and harness powerful AI-driven automation. What You’ll Do

    • Stay updated with industry trends, AI-driven testing methods, and emerging best practices, continually seeking ways to enhance our testing processes.


Requirements

What We’re Looking For

    • Proven expertise in testing web applications built with Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

    • Proficiency in TypeScript-based automation tools (Cypress or similar) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.

    • Experience with bug tracking/test management tools (JIRA, TestRail).

  • Technical Knowledge:

    • Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.

    • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Soft Skills:

    • Detail-oriented mindset and a passion for quality.

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    • Collaborative spirit and adaptability in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Nice-to-Haves:

    • Performance testing (JMeter) experience.

    • An interest in the creator economy, social commerce, or AI-driven solutions.


Benefits

  • Empower Creators:Your work supports an ecosystem where creators monetize their passions, connect with premium brands, and scale their businesses.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology:Embrace modern frameworks, AI-driven automation, and continuous innovation.

  • Professional Growth:Access opportunities for learning, experimentation, and career advancement in a rapidly evolving startup.

  • Collaborative Culture:Join a diverse, inclusive team that values open communication, shared knowledge, and mutual success.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re excited about delivering high-quality digital experiences, enabling creators to thrive, and working with forward-thinking technology, we want to hear from you. Join Snef in Jakarta and shape the future of social commerce.Send us your resumeand let’s build something extraordinary together!

HEALTH

WEALTH

About the role

As Solution Architect, Medical Imaging, you'll define and govern the end‑to‑end architecture for medical imaging solutions across the product landscape.

Working remotely in the UK, in this newly created role your brief will be to ensure that applications, domains, and platform services integrate coherently to deliver scalable, reliable and compliant imaging workflows which support global clinical trials.

Deploying your combination of architectural experience and deep medical imaging domain knowledge, you'll translate product strategy and business objectives into solution‑level architectural direction, aligning multiple domains, teams and stakeholders around a unified technical vision. You'll be responsible for product‑wide architectural consistency, non‑functional requirements, security and regulatory alignment and technical risk management. Working closely with Product, Clinical, QA/RA, Security, Platform Engineering and Application Architects, your priority will be to guide architectural decisions which balance delivery efficiency, long‑term sustainability and business value.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Requirements Definition & Management

  • ​Own product-level translation of functional and non-functional requirements across domains

  • ​Define and align NFRs (availability, scalability, resilience, security, privacy) for the product/portfolio

  • ​Harmonize cross-domain requirements; resolve conflicts and drive consistent interpretation

  • ​Coordinate constraints and dependencies with Platform, Data, Security, QA/RA, and Clinical stakeholders

  • ​Run architecture refinement forums; align roadmap with technical runway and compliance needs

  • ​Establish requirement management practices and traceability expectations across programs

  • ​Arbitrate competing priorities across teams and stakeholders; manage systemic risks

  • Standardize ADR taxonomy and governance processes across the product line

Cloud‑Native SaaS Architecture Design

  • ​​Define product-wide cloud topology and regional deployment strategy

  • ​Coordinate cross-domain HA/DR, failover patterns, and capacity planning

  • ​Approve major service choices, integration patterns, and data-plane/compute strategies

  • ​Drive security-by-design and zero-trust posture across the product line

  • ​Standardizemessaging, API contract, and integration approaches across domains

  • ​Define portfolio SLIs/SLOs and operationalguardrails;review deviations

  • ​Mentor application architects on distributed systems decisions and cloud trade-offs

  • ​Plan evolution for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency across programs

​AI‑Driven Medical Imaging Platform Development

  • ​Align AI services and capabilities across the product line to avoid duplication

  • ​Define experimentation and rollout patterns (shadow, A/B, canary) with rollback strategies

  • ​Coordinate validation plans with QA/RA and Clinical SMEs for regulated releases

  • ​Establish AI governance checkpoints and product-level KPIs

  • ​Plan capacity for accelerators (GPU) and cost controls for AI workloads

  • ​Standardize AI architecture (registries, drift detection, retraining cadence) across programs

  • ​Harmonize AI risk controls and documentation/evidence packages

  • ​Guide adoption of emerging AI capabilities that fit clinical and regulatory needs

​Medical Image Viewer Integration & Workflow Design

  • ​Unify viewer workflows and UX patterns across the product line
